purpose: A score-blind, transport-only successor for the failed Nous Flash v1 HANNA route. GPT-5.6 Sol remains the primary condition; v1 failures remain immutable historical evidence.

transport_pilot.success_rule: Exactly three independent schema-valid provider completions, each with one logical provider request, zero recovered retryable failures, valid provider/model/reasoning/runtime/prompt bindings, and duration below 100 seconds.

failure_successor.rule: If this pilot fails or reaches the duration boundary, preserve v2 evidence and preregister v3; never mutate v2.

development.comparison_rule: Any full-development comparison is unmatched to primary batch-32 unless separately frozen paired Sol batch-16 cells exist.

privacy.pilot: No HANNA ratings, correlations, scores, or prose-derived public analysis are produced during the pilot.
privacy.human_judging: Uses only existing HANNA material; no new human judging or contact.
privacy.remote: Nous receives only the authorized per-cell judge input in the external work directory; no private repository content is sent.

interpretation_limits: Transport failure does not promote Nous Pro.
This route supplements and never replaces GPT-5.6 Sol.
No DSPy prompt optimization is part of this successor.
